ValidationRule.description: Validates that the lead State/Province is a valid two-character abbreviation if Country is US, USA, United States, or blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( OR(Country = "US", Country = "USA", Country = "United States", ISBLANK(Country)), OR( LEN(State) < 2, NOT( CONTAINS("AL:AK:AZ:AR:CA:CO:CT:DE:DC:FL:GA:HI:ID:" & "IL:IN:IA:KS:KY:LA:ME:MD:MA:MI:MN:MS:MO:MT:NE:NV:NH:" & "NJ:NM:NY:NC:ND:OH:OK:OR:PA:RI:SC:SD:TN:TX:UT:VT:VA:" & "WA:WV:WI:WY:DC", State) )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A valid two-letter state abbreviation is required.
